scenes.art: Human imagery is replaced by dark interface cards and large high-contrast text.
scenes.rebuild: Stage the eye as a short establishing insert, then add market-card layers around a protected central headline rather than moving all layers at equal visual weight.

scenes.title: Newspaper crop changes the register
scenes.description: Oversized newspaper-style serif text occupies a curved surface; the crop advances into individual words.
scenes.editing: A discrete cut substitutes editorial commentary for the card field. The notes do not establish a literal card-to-paper morph.
scenes.motion: The apparent view pushes closer to typography until complete-page context is lost and words become graphic forms.
scenes.art: Large serif letters and a paper-like surface distinguish this from the sans serif UI.
scenes.rebuild: Create a separate editorial text surface and crop sequence; use a clear cut from the cards, then enlarge the specific words that carry the claim.

scenes.title: A warm sentence holds
scenes.description: Warm, defocused live-action imagery sits behind a short centered sentence. The sentence disappears before the underlying shot.
scenes.editing: A longer atmospheric interval follows the opening’s quick texture changes; the staggered exit leaves an image-only tail.
scenes.motion: The text fades out while the footage remains, separating the copy event from the shot boundary.
scenes.art: Red/orange warmth and soft focus contrast with the cool black interface scenes.
scenes.rebuild: Keep the copy sharp and the footage subordinate; finish the sentence’s fade before the cut so the shot has a brief visual release.

scenes.title: Claim above an approaching product plane
scenes.description: White copy builds above a low, oblique plane of market cards. The copy completes and clears as the interface occupies more of the frame.
scenes.editing: The reveal gives the claim, product context and upcoming interaction separate jobs in sequence.
scenes.motion: The UI plane grows toward the viewer while the headline builds, then fades; it is already present before becoming the main subject.
scenes.art: White sans serif copy floats over a charcoal interface with dark surrounding space.
scenes.rebuild: Place a broad UI surface below the headline, animate its scale/position toward a readable endpoint, and remove the copy before the important card selection.

scenes.title: Nominate one Bitcoin action
scenes.description: A Bitcoin market card dominates; surrounding content softens and the cursor selects the positive action.
scenes.editing: The edit moves from an interface field to one actionable unit, then allows the selected state to serve as proof.
scenes.motion: Scale isolates the card; the pointer moves to the button; the bright green state marks the consequence.
scenes.art: A warm Bitcoin identifier and green action stand out against charcoal panels and softened surroundings.
scenes.rebuild: Use a focused card insert with the same state as the context view. Move the pointer to a stable target before changing the button, keeping other cards visibly secondary.

scenes.title: Flash into a trading-floor analogy
scenes.description: A white flash bridges to warm trading-floor footage with a short centered product-category phrase.
scenes.editing: The flash covers a material/register change from constructed UI to live-action association.
scenes.motion: The main change is the shot replacement and brief flash, while the centered wording stabilizes the new image.
scenes.art: Warm footage and white copy contrast with the black/green product chapter.
scenes.rebuild: Use the flash at the join between prepared shots; keep the product-category line centered and give the footage enough exposure to read as an analogy.

scenes.title: Price, timer and chart become evidence
scenes.description: Market price/count changes are followed by closer views of a timer and graph.
scenes.editing: A chain of detail views replaces a long, undirected dashboard hold. Each crop answers a different evidence question.
scenes.motion: Numeric state changes occur within UI; successive reframings move attention from values to timer to graph.
scenes.art: The same dark product system persists, with yellow/orange chart accents separating the data emphasis.
scenes.rebuild: Plan the crop order from the information needed: value, time, trend. Animate only the relevant value/state inside each crop and keep recognizable interface elements at the edges.

scenes.title: Explanation yields to the order panel
scenes.description: Short copy at left shares the screen with order-book UI at right. The interface then takes over the field.
scenes.editing: A paired explanation/mechanism layout introduces the control before the film commits to its close-up.
scenes.motion: The order panel increases its share of the composition as the text is removed.
scenes.art: White left-side copy balances dense charcoal UI at right.
scenes.rebuild: Start with a two-part layout and a clear gutter; move the panel into the main reading area after the explanatory phrase has completed.

scenes.title: Leverage: context, grasp, value, release
scenes.description: The pointer approaches a leverage slider. A separate enlarged insert shows the hand grasping and dragging it toward 5.0, then the view returns to the order panel and buy action.
scenes.editing: The enlarged control is an insert inside a causal action chain, not a disconnected beauty shot. The return makes the next click understandable.
scenes.motion: The hand changes from open to closed, the thumb travels along the slider, the value rises after a brief dip, and the hand opens on release.
scenes.art: Oversized white hand and value are legible over a dark rounded slider; bright green action remains the contextual cue.
scenes.rebuild: Make context and insert states share one parameter. Key the hand’s grasp before the thumb travel, synchronize the displayed number, open the hand at the endpoint, then restore the wide panel.

scenes.title: The result changes before the interface clears
scenes.description: Position/result bars shift through red and green states, with changing lengths and values, before the UI darkens.
scenes.editing: The outcome follows the demonstrated input. The outgoing darkening closes the product chapter after the result rather than immediately after the click.
scenes.motion: Bar length, numeric state and color change together; the composition then loses brightness.
scenes.art: Red/green encode different result states against the black/charcoal interface.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare distinct pre-action and result states; change the bar and value as one event, hold the useful result, then dim the whole interface for the next chapter.

scenes.title: A thirteen-second terminal chapter
scenes.description: Pale green identity and small monospaced lines accumulate on black, including a staged integration/merge sequence.
scenes.editing: The long sparse chapter interrupts the dense product cadence. Its duration is a structural reset, not a missing animation opportunity.
scenes.motion: Lines appear in place with limited spatial movement; attention follows sequential text and integration states.
scenes.art: Terminal-like green, small monospace lettering and abundant black space replace large product crops.
scenes.rebuild: Lay out a fixed terminal region and reveal meaningful lines/state updates in order. Budget reading exposure for each completed message and avoid an unrelated moving background.

scenes.title: Pair two symbols before the burst
scenes.description: Two platform symbols settle into a symmetric pairing, narrow in profile, and move together.
scenes.editing: The pairing translates the preceding integration idea into a compact visual bridge to the identity coda.
scenes.motion: A visible change toward narrow profiles suggests turning symbols; the pair converges while maintaining a simple centered arrangement.
scenes.art: Two high-contrast marks on dark ground keep the relationship legible.
scenes.rebuild: Stage the two marks in balanced positions, bring their profiles toward each other, and complete the relationship before introducing the material sequence. Do not assume the source’s 3D construction.

scenes.title: Fast material replacements preserve identity
scenes.description: After a white flash, a centered Worm silhouette switches among gold, fabric-like color, rainbow, metal, white, wire-like, spiky and globe-like treatments.
scenes.editing: The action is a montage of prepared variants. Many appearances in the dense window last roughly two source frames at 30fps.
scenes.motion: The invariant is central position and recognizable outline; most energy comes from material replacement rather than a large trajectory.
scenes.art: Black ground allows metallic, bright and patterned marks to change character without changing the whole set.
scenes.rebuild: Align each variant to a common anchor and silhouette size. Use short cuts only where the mark is already recognizable; do not attach essential explanatory copy to these exposures.

scenes.title: White URL end card
scenes.description: Black URL lettering appears on a white field, grows gradually and is followed by the final dark frame.
scenes.editing: A hard dark-to-light inversion makes the destination immediately distinct from the material burst. The sustained end card resolves the film.
scenes.motion: The URL increases slowly in apparent scale; the field otherwise stays empty.
scenes.art: Plain black sans serif text on white removes the earlier texture and color complexity.
scenes.rebuild: Cut to a clean destination card, preserve generous margins as the URL scales, and hold it long enough to read before the final dark frame.

techniques.title: The leverage insert, frame by frame
steps: The control is first seen inside the order panel with its 1.0x state; the pointer travels upward toward the slider.
The pointer becomes an open hand at the thumb. A much larger control insert replaces the wider view.
The hand closes for the drag. The displayed value briefly dips toward 0.9 before rising; the exact interpolation cannot be recovered from these samples.
The thumb and number progress together toward 5.0x. The framing follows enough of the slider to keep the moving target readable.
At 5.0x the hand opens again. The subsequent wider sequence restores the order panel and continues to the buy action.
techniques.takeaway: Give a magnified control an entry context, visible grasp, synchronized parameter change and release. The close-up should complete an action the viewer already understands.
techniques.certainty: Consecutive source frames 675–719 at 30fps were inspected. The larger beat continues to approximately 25.2 s; easing and source software are unknown.

techniques.title: Fast cuts with a stable silhouette
steps: The paired symbols finish their approach/turn before the identity burst.
A brief bright transition introduces the material sequence.
Prepared central marks replace one another while their location and broad outline remain comparable.
Several treatments repeat in a short cycle; many variants occupy roughly two 30 fps source frames.
A hard cut removes the dark stage and substitutes the sparse white URL card.
techniques.takeaway: The repeatable silhouette carries recognition, allowing surface variation to run much faster than readable information.
techniques.certainty: Consecutive source frames 1290–1391 inspected; this establishes visible replacement timing, not a continuously morphing material process.

structure: Typed introduction joke → device and balance request → balance proof → market recommendations → one phone turn → place-order conversation → sell/reversal conversation → personality question → small brand close.
editingSystem: A conversation turn is the edit unit. Questions appear beside a full device; answers earn close screen views. The phone alternates sides to change composition while the same conversation supplies continuity. Each transactional chapter includes request, choice/confirmation and completed state.
motionSystem: Type-on wording, blur/fade exits, lateral phone relocation and scale changes form the main vocabulary. The front-facing screen is the readable destination. A single turn at 13.5–14.5 s passes through edge and back, reduces size and relocates the phone left before the next prompt.
artSystem: An almost empty white stage, black sans serif copy, green conversation surface, warm metallic phone and small yellow/orange accents. The device is the recurring physical anchor. There is no need for decorative environment changes: layout variation and the next question carry the progression.
reconstruction: Suggested implementation: prepare a single chronological conversation with all requests, answers, confirmations and completed states. Derive close-ups from that same conversation.
Build two wide compositions—device left/prompt right and device right/prompt left—and one large response crop. Reuse this grammar across chapters.
Type the prompt in meaningful units, soften outgoing copy and move into the response. Reserve a stable close view for the completed answer.
Use one phone rotation as a chapter hinge. Keep side/back exposure short and finish on a front-facing screen at the next wide-layout endpoint.
Close on a small warm mark on the existing white field; do not introduce a new visual world after the conversation has finished.

scenes.title: Introduction grows, then deletes
scenes.description: Small typed introductory wording enlarges beyond the frame, retracts/deletes and clears; a warm caret accompanies the text.
scenes.editing: The familiar presentation opening becomes a short joke through exaggeration and cancellation.
scenes.motion: Type-on and apparent enlargement are followed by deletion/clearance rather than a conventional title fade.
scenes.art: Black sans serif lettering and a yellow/orange caret sit on a white field.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare the complete text and caret as independent layers; exaggerate the title scale, then delete/retract it to leave a clean field for the conversational opening.

scenes.title: Salutation gives the stage to a phone
scenes.description: A brief greeting builds, softens, and gives way to an upright phone.
scenes.editing: The outgoing greeting bridges the joke to the product demonstration; it does not compete with the incoming screen.
scenes.motion: Text blur/fade makes the outgoing layer subordinate while the device enters and settles upright.
scenes.art: White remains constant; warm metallic edges give the otherwise minimal object a material presence.
scenes.rebuild: Finish the greeting first, then soften it as the phone enters. Settle the phone before expecting viewers to inspect its content.

scenes.title: First question defines the grammar
scenes.description: The phone sits left; a balance request builds at right. Framing moves into the phone’s conversation.
scenes.editing: A wide prompt/device layout establishes who asks and where the answer appears, then a close crop prioritizes proof.
scenes.motion: Words accumulate beside a relatively stable device; scale/reframing brings the conversation forward.
scenes.art: Black request text balances the green screen on the empty white stage.
scenes.rebuild: Use separate prompt and device layers in a two-column composition; after the request completes, enlarge the relevant conversation region rather than the entire scene indiscriminately.

scenes.title: Hold the balance answer
scenes.description: The balance response remains large in the frame.
scenes.editing: A distinct reading interval separates the answer from the next request.
scenes.motion: The dominant screen crop stays comparatively settled instead of beginning the next relocation immediately.
scenes.art: The green chat surface and pale message bubbles occupy most of the useful visual area.
scenes.rebuild: Budget a stable response hold after its last content change. Measure readability at the delivery size before trimming this interval.

scenes.title: Swap sides for recommendations
scenes.description: Phone moves to the right while the next request builds at left; the composition then approaches recommended-market content.
scenes.editing: The side swap varies the repeated question/answer structure without changing its meaning.
scenes.motion: Lateral relocation opens a text region, then scale/reframing enlarges the answer.
scenes.art: The same white, black and green vocabulary persists; no new background is needed to signal a new capability.
scenes.rebuild: Mirror the wide-layout roles while preserving type size and device treatment; finish on the answer crop after the prompt rather than adding an unrelated transition.

scenes.title: One turn resets the composition
scenes.description: The phone passes through front, narrow edge and gold back, shrinks, moves left and faces forward beside the next prompt.
scenes.editing: A compact object transition joins one conversation chapter to another and restores the wide explanatory layout.
scenes.motion: Rotation, scale reduction and leftward relocation overlap; the readable front view is the endpoint.
scenes.art: Warm gold back and edges briefly contrast with the green screen before it returns.
scenes.rebuild: Animate the device between known wide-layout endpoints; let the turn occupy the travel, and arrive front-facing before the next sentence needs attention.

scenes.title: A playful order request
scenes.description: The request to place a specific bet accumulates beside the phone. The copy softens while the response expands into view.
scenes.editing: The repeated phrase is a recognizable refrain; humor stays in the prompt while the device remains the mechanism.
scenes.motion: Type-on builds the request, then blur/fade and reframing hand attention to the screen.
scenes.art: Large black prompt text is paired with the restrained green conversation UI and white surroundings.
scenes.rebuild: Keep the request outside the device for readability, then reduce its contrast and enlarge the response as separate stages so neither competes for equal emphasis.

scenes.title: Show the complete order chain
scenes.description: Market choices, confirmation detail and completed-order state advance in the same conversation.
scenes.editing: The sequence stays with the transaction through completion instead of cutting away after a feature selection.
scenes.motion: Conversation content changes locally while the close screen framing preserves continuity.
scenes.art: Consistent message styling makes choices, confirmation and completion feel like one system.
scenes.rebuild: Build distinct selectable, confirmation and completed states in one conversation asset; show each in causal order and preserve the previous context where it explains the next state.

scenes.title: Reverse the operation
scenes.description: The phone moves right for a sell request; the frame then closes in on confirmation and the sold state.
scenes.editing: The reversal demonstrates a second operation using an already learned visual grammar.
scenes.motion: Device relocation opens the question area, then the answer enlarges; the conversation continues rather than resetting to a fresh screen.
scenes.art: The same device material and chat palette reduce the visual learning needed for the new action.
scenes.rebuild: Reuse the wide-to-close transition with a genuine continuation of the prior order. Include the final sold state so the reversal has a visible result.

scenes.title: A personality turn after proof
scenes.description: An unrelated philosophical question appears beside the phone, followed by a short answer in close view.
scenes.editing: A nonfunctional exchange comes after the product workflow has already been established; it serves as a closing character beat.
scenes.motion: Prompt build and response enlargement repeat the established motion pattern.
scenes.art: The sparse white stage keeps attention on the wording rather than introducing a comedic visual prop.
scenes.rebuild: Place personality copy after the mechanism and result. Use the same presentation rules so the joke feels like part of the product rather than an appended title card.

scenes.title: Small warm identity, then fade
scenes.description: A small warm-colored brand mark holds on white and fades.
scenes.editing: The restrained close resolves the conversation without a late escalation.
scenes.motion: The mark is comparatively static; the last visible change is its fade.
scenes.art: The yellow/orange identity accent returns on the existing white field.
scenes.rebuild: Remove device and prompt layers, center the small mark with generous margins, then hold and fade after recognition.

techniques.title: Phone turn as a chapter hinge
steps: The opening frames still show the close front conversation view.
The phone turns toward a narrow edge, exposing its warm metal profile.
The gold-colored back appears briefly; the device simultaneously becomes smaller and shifts toward the left-side position.
The front screen returns as the next right-side prompt starts with a short greeting.
The front-facing device settles; the prompt continues building while the screen remains available for the following answer.
techniques.takeaway: A turn is useful when it changes the composition and prepares a readable destination; the back of the object is a transition state, not the information-bearing endpoint.
techniques.certainty: Consecutive source frames 324–347 at 24 fps confirm front/edge/back/front progression. Exact easing, rotation angles and authoring method are not established.

structure: Wordmark → categories → deposit mechanism → heatmap activation → orderbook detail → Explore navigation → whale analytics → wallet labeling workflow → chart order workflow → option breadth → typed brand close.
editingSystem: Feature chapters alternate short titles with longer interface actions. The recurring explanatory chain is label, target, input, visible change and readable result. Close crops follow the next useful detail, then widen enough to retain interface context. Some labels arrive after the demonstration, using the action itself to establish meaning.
motionSystem: Frontal scaling/crop travel, local cursor motion, character reveals and data changes dominate. Heatmap activation couples a pullback with the arrival of purple data. Later lateral travel connects neighboring panels, while form completion and option changes remain in recognizable frames. The evidence does not require a complex 3D camera.
artSystem: Near-black panels merge into a black field. White sans serif headings occupy empty regions, orange-red marks identify the brand, and green, magenta and purple remain functional data colors. Introductory grayscale imagery/scanline texture gives way to cleaner analytical evidence. A faint wireframe whale is confined to the relevant metaphor.
reconstruction: Suggested implementation: storyboard each feature with five named states—label, target, input, changed state, readable result—before planning camera/crop moves.
Use a consistent flat interface master and derive wide/detail crops from it. Move the crop only when the next relevant evidence lies outside the current reading area.
Separate pointer, selected tool, data overlay, tooltip and result. Sequence these changes so the viewer sees a trigger before the result.
Allocate longer stable views to wallet naming, category selection and order confirmation than to chapter headings. These are workflows, not decorative screens.
Let UI panel edges disappear into the dark field; reserve the brand caret and color accents for specific roles rather than outlining every component.

scenes.title: Small wordmark with a caret
scenes.description: Characters assemble a compact central wordmark with an orange-red rectangular caret.
scenes.editing: A restrained identifier precedes the dense product film and establishes the closing motif.
scenes.motion: Character reveal supplies the activity; the central placement stays stable.
scenes.art: White lettering, a warm rectangular caret and black ground create the brand’s minimum vocabulary.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare character states and a separate caret; keep the opening compact enough that the first category composition feels like an expansion.

scenes.title: One active category in a stacked list
scenes.description: The active word changes within a stacked asset-category list while grayscale market imagery changes behind it.
scenes.editing: A fixed text position joins different subjects into one expanding claim.
scenes.motion: Activity is largely in word emphasis and background replacement rather than a whole-frame camera move.
scenes.art: Monochrome imagery stays behind a high-contrast list; selective color identifies the current item.
scenes.rebuild: Keep the category stack fixed, vary only the active treatment, and cut background imagery in conceptual groups that correspond to each selected word.

scenes.title: Deposit mechanism as a three-part path
scenes.description: A deposit title gives way to a funding-source grid, orange-red intermediary rectangle and destination mark, joined by small connectors.
scenes.editing: The feature is explained as a route through components rather than named over a generic dashboard.
scenes.motion: Highlights and connectors cycle through source cells while the left-to-right relationship remains constant.
scenes.art: Small source marks, thin connectors and one warm intermediary form a sparse diagram on black.
scenes.rebuild: Place sources, routing block and destination on stable anchors; animate one source highlight and connector path at a time so breadth remains countable.

scenes.title: Heatmap: trigger, state, detail, context
scenes.description: Analytics/heatmap titles introduce a chart. A pointer reaches the toolbar, the view widens, purple heatmap data arrives, and the crop moves into cells/tooltip before widening to a side panel.
scenes.editing: The chapter’s cut/reframe order follows an explicit explanation: identify feature, show input, reveal change, inspect a detail, restore context.
scenes.motion: The toolbar approach precedes the pullback. Purple data builds as the wider chart settles; later enlargement brings cells and a tooltip into reading range.
scenes.art: Purple heatmap bands become the focal layer against black with green/magenta candle data.
scenes.rebuild: Build the base chart and heatmap as separate layers; show the tool input before revealing the overlay, then make a detail crop whose tooltip remains readable.

scenes.title: Orderbook gets its own inspection
scenes.description: An orderbook title gives way to the chart/orderbook together, then a closer view of rows and linked detail.
scenes.editing: A short chapter label introduces a longer stable demonstration; a crop removes irrelevant dashboard area.
scenes.motion: Pointer action is local, while framing approaches the rows needed to understand the relationship.
scenes.art: Dense numeric rows retain the dark UI and contrasting data colors rather than adopting a decorative new style.
scenes.rebuild: Start with the orderbook’s place beside the chart, enlarge the active rows, and preserve enough column/header context that the numbers remain interpretable.

scenes.title: Navigation connects the chapters
scenes.description: A close crop of navigation shows Explore being selected, followed by a grid of small cohort charts.
scenes.editing: The next chapter is motivated by an interface action rather than an arbitrary title wipe.
scenes.motion: The pointer selects navigation; the resulting grid establishes breadth before later detail.
scenes.art: Repeated small charts create a coherent analytical field within the black UI.
scenes.rebuild: Show the navigation label before selection, then reveal the resulting chart grid as the direct state change. Keep cell proportions consistent so range reads as a system.

scenes.title: Whale metaphor becomes functional data
scenes.description: A faint wireframe whale appears below the analytics interface; the view approaches a positioning graph, then travels to a green/red block map.
scenes.editing: The metaphor introduces the topic and recedes as the data earns attention. Neighboring panels are connected by crop travel.
scenes.motion: The frame moves into the graph and laterally across to the block map; the literal whale remains subordinate.
scenes.art: A subtle line illustration sits behind cleaner charts; green/red blocks carry the final analytical emphasis.
scenes.rebuild: Use the whale only to establish the chapter. Lower its contrast before the data close-up, then move between adjacent panels along a planned path rather than crossfading unrelated screenshots.

scenes.title: Wallet labeling is a sustained action chain
scenes.description: Smart-money title, wallet ranking, individual wallet, alias entry, category selection and save unfold in order.
scenes.editing: The film remains with a complete task through saving; the longer passage supplies proof beyond a list of capabilities.
scenes.motion: Selection and form content change locally; framing gives the active row or field enough size to inspect.
scenes.art: White headings and restrained form UI keep dense labels readable on the dark stage.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare a ranking view and a consistent detail state. Show selection, typing, category choice and save as separate events, holding the final named wallet before the next chapter.

scenes.title: Chart order proceeds to confirmation
scenes.description: An activity list shares space with a chart. Pointer action opens an order popover, amount changes, confirmation occurs and an order line appears on the chart. A chart-trading title arrives near the end.
scenes.editing: The result establishes the feature before its final label. Keeping the chart visible makes the new line a traceable consequence.
scenes.motion: The popover appears at the active context; the amount changes and the order line arrives after confirmation.
scenes.art: The dense chart/list context stays dark, while the popover and line isolate the actionable state.
scenes.rebuild: Keep chart coordinates consistent across the popover and confirmation; introduce the order line only after the visible confirmation so its cause is clear.

scenes.title: Scope through stable option changes
scenes.description: The order panel sits with a large feature title as tabs and menu options change.
scenes.editing: Repeated local selections communicate breadth without requiring a fresh composition for every option.
scenes.motion: Tab/menu state changes carry most of the movement; the panel location stays recognizable.
scenes.art: Large white title and smaller dark control panels form a clear hierarchy.
scenes.rebuild: Hold the panel frame and title position; change one option at a time, including its selected state, so viewers can compare the available modes.

scenes.title: Dense dashboard contracts to typed identity
scenes.description: Sparse typed copy replaces the dashboard, shortens into the brand, and the lockup fades.
scenes.editing: The sudden density drop signals closure; the caret links the ending to the opening.
scenes.motion: Character replacement/deletion concentrates the message while large spatial movement stops.
scenes.art: White type and orange-red caret remain against black after data colors disappear.
scenes.rebuild: Remove the interface cleanly, reveal the final phrase, then reduce it toward the wordmark. Keep the closing mark still before fading.

techniques.title: Heatmap activation: input before data
steps: The chart is initially framed close enough to expose the upper toolbar and the approaching pointer.
The pointer reaches the toolbar target while the candle chart remains visible underneath.
The composition pulls back to reveal more of the chart rather than replacing it with a different screenshot.
Purple heatmap lines begin appearing across the widened chart; their density increases over successive frames.
The wider context settles as the overlay becomes legible, preparing the later cell/tooltip inspection.
techniques.takeaway: Separate trigger, reframe and changed data sufficiently for their causal relationship to read. The wider frame should make room for the new information.
techniques.certainty: Consecutive source frames 240–287 at 24 fps inspected, including both sheets. The overlay visibly builds; its source implementation and exact interpolation are unknown.

structure: Industrial place → CRT object → skeletal character and typing → screen title → clean feature cards → battle/editorial escalation → sparse typed brand relationship. The four main chapters are atmosphere, mechanism, escalation and identity.
editingSystem: The opening reveals place, object and actor before showing the action that enters the product. A brief bright transition covers the change from physical CRT to clean cards. The middle preserves a simple explanatory language; the later montage spends the film’s heavier glitch, duplication and texture changes.
motionSystem: Opening movement comes from shot progression and closer framings around the CRT/character. The screen motivates the push into product. Feature cards use local pointer/state changes, close inspection and pullback. Later montage energy comes from hard replacements, duplicated text and interference; the final typed lockup becomes spatially restrained.
artSystem: Three related systems: green-black industrial scenes lit by practical-looking sources and the CRT; charcoal product cards with mint, magenta and purple data; abrasive footage/newsprint/category typography with scanlines and duplicated imagery. Dark values and a recurring orange caret connect them. The images alone do not establish whether the character footage is live action, CG or generated.
reconstruction: Suggested implementation: write a short opening action with place, object, actor and interaction. Make the CRT or another visible object the narrative route into the product.
Prepare the completed screen title and first clean product composition as separate shots. Cover their join with a short bright transition while preserving the title’s readable completion.
Simplify each middle feature to one large card/diagram and one cause-and-effect action. Protect this chapter from the distortion reserved for the later montage.
Group the escalation by subjects and type categories, then cut between prepared materials. Keep a small set of recurring colors and the caret as continuity cues.
After the busiest montage, strip the field back to typed copy and the compact Hyperdash/PVP relationship. Give that ending a longer readable exposure than individual montage images.

scenes.title: Place, computer, then character
scenes.description: A dark industrial corridor leads to a CRT on a desk, followed by closer views of a hooded skeletal figure.
scenes.editing: The opening supplies a miniature narrative through shot order: location, significant object, actor. It delays the product until the action has a setting.
scenes.motion: Changing viewpoints and closer framings guide attention; the CRT becomes the brightest repeated object.
scenes.art: Green-black haze, overhead practical-looking lights, heavy shadow and the white CRT glow establish the fictional world.
scenes.rebuild: Storyboard distinct place/object/actor views and use the screen as a consistent light/focal cue. Preserve recognizable spatial relationships when selecting the closer shots.

scenes.title: Typing turns the CRT into a doorway
scenes.description: An overhead screen/keyboard view shows a skeletal hand typing. Static collapses and computer text/new Hyperdash title appears as the view moves closer.
scenes.editing: The physical action motivates the announcement. The film enters software through an object already established in the story.
scenes.motion: Hand/key action is followed by screen-state change and a closer screen framing. The title builds before the chapter transition.
scenes.art: CRT curvature, scanlines and green-black light remain visible around bright text and the orange caret.
scenes.rebuild: Make the screen content a controllable layer inside the CRT view; sequence typing, interference clearance, title completion and push-in before leaving the physical set.

scenes.title: Flash into a simplified heatmap
scenes.description: A bright flash gives way to clean liquidation-heatmap copy, a purple strip, cursor, chart and tooltip.
scenes.editing: The bright join deliberately separates the atmospheric chapter from readable product explanation; it is not evidence of a continuous CRT-to-chart morph.
scenes.motion: Copy, purple strip and chart elements settle in sequence after the flash; the pointer supplies a local inspection event.
scenes.art: Clean dark cards and purple data replace the textured industrial scene while preserving the dark value range.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare a simple flat product composition and reveal its layers after the flash. Keep the new heading and chart free of CRT distortion so the benefit can be inspected.

scenes.title: One analytics card carries the claim
scenes.description: An analytics card shows changing figures with local cursor movement and a close inspection/pullback.
scenes.editing: The isolated card replaces a full dashboard, giving one feature a discrete reading interval.
scenes.motion: Numeric state changes and pointer movement stay local; framing changes emphasize the relevant card region.
scenes.art: Charcoal card surfaces and contrasting mint/magenta data continue the cleaner middle chapter.
scenes.rebuild: Extract only the data necessary for this feature. Keep the card shape and position recognizable while enlarging the relevant figure and returning to the complete card.

scenes.title: Repeated follow actions show the rule
scenes.description: A short wallet list shows successive follow-button selections, with corresponding row states.
scenes.editing: Repeated cause and effect teaches one feature through visible examples rather than through a broad title claim.
scenes.motion: The pointer visits separate rows; each button changes after its own selection.
scenes.art: Aligned rows and consistent active states make the repetition easy to compare.
scenes.rebuild: Use one row component repeated in a short list. Sequence pointer arrival, press and row state change for each target; leave completed states visible while moving on.

scenes.title: Parallel positions explain autotrade
scenes.description: An autotrade card expands into two positions lists shown side by side.
scenes.editing: The paired layout makes a relationship visible through correspondence between lists.
scenes.motion: The compact card gives way to wider parallel panels; their readable alignment becomes the endpoint.
scenes.art: Matching panel treatment and row structure foreground similarity rather than a decorative new palette.
scenes.rebuild: Prepare corresponding row structures and reveal the paired lists in one common frame. Match alignment and comparable hierarchy so viewers can inspect the relationship.

scenes.title: Battle and editorial montage raise intensity
scenes.description: An abrupt cut introduces a skeletal army/fantasy battle, returns to CRT imagery, then moves through footage, newspaper crops and large market/category words.
scenes.editing: A second energy peak follows the explanatory middle. Hard replacements and clusters of related subjects expand the world/category range.
scenes.motion: Glitches, duplicated imagery/text, color shifts and scanlines create rapid change; no single continuous camera path unifies the chapter.
scenes.art: The collage mixes serif category words, newsprint and electronic interference over a generally dark value range.
scenes.rebuild: Assemble short concept clusters rather than applying one effect continuously. Use duplication/glitch as selected punctuation; preserve enough category-word exposure for their intended role.

scenes.title: Typed claim reduces to a relationship lockup
scenes.description: A short central claim types on, deletes/replaces into Hyperdash, then gains the PVP relationship underneath.
scenes.editing: The montage’s density collapses into a compact readable ending; the brand relationship becomes the final information.
scenes.motion: Character events replace large scene changes. The completed lockup holds on the dark field.
scenes.art: White central text and orange caret reconnect the close to the earlier screen title; the secondary relationship sits below.
scenes.rebuild: Clear the montage before typing the final line. Reduce it into the main wordmark, add the secondary relationship as a separate event, and hold the completed hierarchy.

techniques.title: Screen-to-product handoff
steps: The close CRT title continues typing until the Hyperdash 2.0 line is complete; the orange caret remains a visible accent.
The completed title receives a brief legible exposure on the curved, dark screen.
A bright frame washes across the join, concealing the material change from CRT imagery to a flat product layout.
The liquidation-heatmap heading and purple horizontal strip become visible on the cleaner black field.
Supporting copy and chart candles arrive in stages; the product composition settles before later cursor/tooltip detail.
techniques.takeaway: Finish the old scene’s message, hide the material switch at a purposeful bright join, then establish the new scene in layers. The product chapter needs a readable landing, not continuous distortion.
techniques.certainty: Consecutive source frames 312–347 at 24 fps inspected. A flash-covered edit and staged arrival are visible; a continuous geometric morph or specific production pipeline is not established.
